objective: Build the one-page website for Zero To One ($ZTO), a plain community token launched through the IMD swarm as launch #737. Token contract: 0xd782bdea4ef02a0bd391eb9089470c8080f0a68e on Ethereum (chainId 1), paired with IMD in a Uniswap v4 pool. The page shows: the name and symbol; one line on what it is (A plain community token. No fees, no minting after launch, no owner powers, no transfer rules.); the token address with a copy button and a block-explorer link; a buy link to the Uniswap swap page with the token prefilled; total supply 1,000,000,000 and the launch split (88% pool, 10% swarm, the rest to the launcher wallet); a link to the swarm launch page and the source repository (https://github.com/identity-md-launches/launch-737-zero-to-one); and a plain statement that it is a community token with no team promises and that nothing on the page is financial advice. Idea to build the page around: zero to one, the step from nothing to something. ZTO marks the swarm going from test chains to a real one, so the hero is a large "0 → 1" set in type (no image), with the name under it; carry the 0 and 1 motif lightly through the page (section numbers 00, 01, 02; a thin progress rule that runs from 0 to 1). Look: a sibling of imd.fun, not a copy. Keep what makes imd.fun recognisable: monospace type throughout, a near-black page with white text in dark mode and the reverse in light, flat panels with hairline borders, lower-case labels, lots of empty space, no gradients, no rounded cards, no illustrations or mascots. Make it its own: a warm amber accent (about #f5a623 on dark, a darker amber on light) wherever imd.fun uses terminal green, and never green as the accent; its own wordmark, the symbol with the 0 → 1 mark; the system monospace stack rather than imd.fun's font. Do not use the IMD name, logo or wordmark as this site's own branding, and do not present the token as official IMD. Say once, in the footer, that it was built by the IMD swarm, with a link to imd.fun. Static site, no backend, no wallet connection, no analytics, no external scripts or fonts; works at phone width; light and dark themes.
